event.description: Factor learned absolute positions through a four-dimensional code
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Current retained frontier is 5,824 parameters at 99.900000%, a +0.900000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There are 0 prior attempts in this family, so there is no most recent accepted or failed in-family result. Hypothesis: the 35 learned 16-dimensional absolute position vectors occupy a much lower-dimensional task-relevant subspace; replacing them with learned 4-dimensional position codes plus one shared bias-free projection is a representational change that removes 356 parameters while preserving adaptable absolute positions. This is more informative than the nearest untested fixed sinusoidal alternative because it directly tests positional rank while avoiding the confound of eliminating learned positional adaptation entirely. The preceding attempt-0002 accepted the current frontier under the repaired 45,000-step training control.
